tips.text: Stack a Resource Booster, Drop Chance Booster, relay blessing and a Resourceful Retriever companion for the resources.
Bring a looter frame such as Nekros, Khora or Hydroid; it is the biggest multiplier.
Farm Polymer Bundle and Plastids together at Uranus, on Assur or Ophelia.
Pick up Nano Spores and Neurodes in one pass on Eris.
Set Distilling Extractors on Saturn and Uranus to bring back Plastids passively.
Break the Infested Cysts in the Cambion Drift for Plastids and Nano Spores.
It is a cheap Market buy and quick Mastery fodder; threads are about using it, not getting it.
